title: Maple Leaf Adventures
specs: Explore the BC and Alaska coast on boutique nature and wildlife expeditions aboard historic and elegant vessels.
Trips visit remote coastlines and wilderness areas including Great Bear Rainforest, Desolation Sound, Haida Gwaii, and Gulf Islands.
Maple Leaf accommodates 8 guests in semi-private double sleeping areas, with 3 shared heads with showers.
Swell accommodates 12 guests in 6 private cabins, all with ensuite heads and showers.
